job.job_title: Lead Data Scientist / Lead AI Engineer GenAI & Advanced ML
job.job_description:
Job Role: Lead Data Scientist / Lead AI Engineer GenAI & Advanced ML
Location: Mumbai / Pune
Job Type: Full-time
Experience: 5 8 years
About the Role
We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist / Lead AI Engineer with strong leadership experience and deep expertise in AI/ML and Generative AI. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who has built, deployed, and scaled AI/ML systems, including Generative AI solutions, while also leading teams, mentoring engineers, and driving architectural decisions.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling, along with real-world experience in Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, etc.). Experience in forecasting, predictive modeling, or advanced analytics should be reflected as part of broader AI/ML problem-solving initiatives.
If you enjoy owning AI strategy end-to-end, leading teams, and building production-grade AI systems, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions across business use cases.
Architect and implement end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Drive Generative AI initiatives, such as:
LLM-based applications
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Prompt engineering and optimization
Fine-tuning and model adaptation
AI agents and orchestration workflows
Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to solve real-world problems, including forecasting, prediction, optimization, and intelligent automation.
Lead and mentor a team of data scientists and AI engineers, conducting code reviews and ensuring best practices.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Design and maintain ML pipelines for experimentation, deployment, retraining, and monitoring.
Perform scenario analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling as part of AI-driven decision support systems.
Ensure AI solutions follow responsible AI principles, scalability, performance, and reliability standards.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and Generative AI ecosystems.
Qualifications & Skills
5 8 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering, with at least 1 2 years in a technical leadership role.
Strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, including:
LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)
Prompt engineering and optimization
RAG pipelines and vector databases
Fine-tuning and inference optimization
Experience applying ML to forecasting, predictive analytics, or time-series related problems as part of broader AI systems.
Proficiency in Python, with strong experience using libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of ML system design, model evaluation, and performance metrics.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage deliverables, and drive projects end-to-end.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
Experience deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure).
Familiarity with MLOps practices (CI/CD, model monitoring, versioning).
Experience with big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop.
Knowledge of vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
Exposure to AI governance, security, and responsible AI frameworks.
